title: Boundary sensitivity of spatial-domain maps can alter downstream summaries in colorectal cancer Visium data
description: Code and derived evidence for evaluating boundary sensitivity across seven spatial-domain approaches in 13 colorectal cancer Visium sections. The release includes coverage and stability tables, switching-boundary localization, histology-gradient context, downstream robustness summaries, computational sensitivity results, full-13 official-implementation sensitivity checks, stability-stratified downstream summaries, molecular tumor-stroma proxy-interface tables, publication figures, and a consolidated supplementary-table workbook.
